description: GOBACK … WITH {ERROR|NORMAL} STATUS [id|lit] phrase, ISO §2023:14.9.18.2 — a COBOL-2023 addition (annex item 32: GOBACK now allows the same status phrase as the STOP statement; §2023:14.9.18.4 GR3 routes a main-program GOBACK to STOP semantics). Distinct edition from the 2002 STOP-status phrase — the shared statusPhrase rule is 2002-gated on STOP, 2023 on GOBACK. GOBACK is valid at 2014 so the below-2023 witness isolates the status phrase.
citation: ISO §2023:14.9.18.2 / §2023:14.9.18.4 GR3; Annex E.3.3 (2023 new-features annex item 32)
